targets.rawSql: SELECT w.test_start AS time, c.template_id AS metric, AVG(w.test_sharpe) OVER (PARTITION BY c.template_id ORDER BY w.test_start ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM walk_forward_results w JOIN candidates c ON c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id WHERE $__timeFilter(w.test_start) ORDER BY w.test_start ASC;

panels.title: Per-template aggregate (avg test Sharpe / MaxDD / window count)

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.template_id, COUNT(*) AS windows, ROUND(AVG(w.test_sharpe)::numeric, 4) AS avg_test_sharpe, ROUND(MAX(w.test_max_dd)::numeric, 4) AS worst_max_dd, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN w.test_sharpe > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)), 4) AS win_rate FROM walk_forward_results w JOIN candidates c ON c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id WHERE $__timeFilter(w.test_start) GROUP BY c.template_id ORDER BY avg_test_sharpe DESC NULLS LAST;
